facts.text: The engineering paper describes a 10-storey, 16,250 m² exposed mass-timber college building using timber-concrete-composite slab bands and CLT infill panels.

The paper reports connector and slab-band tests, including observed failure modes and a final design change to add transverse reinforcing screws to address weak-axis shear in some specimens.
CHM Fire's project page says it developed the approved alternative solution for the exposed mass-timber structure.
